data.name: Jabaz
data.gender_notes: Jabaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gentle, compassionate name derived from the Arabic word 'jabar' meaning power or strength. The name Jabaz carries the meaning “Gentle, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Jabaz usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies inner strength and compassion, inspiring peace and harmony.
data.etymology: Jabaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabaz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جَبَز
in_arabic.meaning: جَبَز يعني الشخص الشجاع وال brave والقوي في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: جَبَز هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الشجاع وال brave والقوي، وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه مشتق من الجََبَز وهو الفعل الذي يعني التغلب على الشيء بشجاعة وجراءة. وقد أُطلق هذا الاسم على بعض الصحابة رضي الله عنهم، ويرتبط بالشجاعة وال courage في المعارك والمواقف الصعبة.

in_urdu.name: جَبَز
in_urdu.meaning: جَبَز کا مطلب ہے بہادر، شجاع، اور قوی شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: جَبَز ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بہادر، شجاع، اور قوی شخص۔ یہ نام بعض صحابی رضی اللہ عنہم کے ناموں میں بھی پایا جاتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا تعلق شجاعت اور بہادری سے ہے، خاص طور پر معارک اور مشکل حالات میں۔

in_hindi.name: जबज़
in_hindi.meaning: जबज़ का अर्थ है बहादुर, शूरवीर और बलवान व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: जबज़ एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है बहादुर, शूरवीर और बलवान व्यक्ति। यह नाम कुछ सहाबा रज़ी अल्लाहु अन्हुम के नामों में भी पाया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका संबंध शूरवीरता और बहादुरी से है, विशेष रूप से युद्धों और कठिन परिस्थितियों में।

in_pashto.name: جَبَز
in_pashto.meaning: جَبَز د قوي او زړور سړي نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جَبَز د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه يی اخستل شوی دی. ددی نوم معنی د قوي او زړور سړي څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د ځینو صحابي رضي الله عنهم په نامه کي موندل کيږي. په اسلامي دود کي ددی نوم اړیکه د زړورتیا او بہادري سره لري، په ځانګړي ډول په جګړو او سختو حالاتو کي.

in_english.name: Jabaz
in_english.long_meaning: Jabaz is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning strong, brave, and powerful person. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'J-B-Z', which conveys the idea of strength, courage, and resilience. Historically, the name Jabaz has been associated with some companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), reflecting its significance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of bravery and fortitude, particularly in battles and challenging situations.

Its origin from the Arabic word 'jabar' evokes the notion of power or strength, but carried out with sensitivity and kindness. The name may be associated with individuals who are known for their soft-spoken and caring nature, and whose actions exhibit strength and gentleness towards others. It is a powerful statement of the balance that can exist between authority and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jabaz can be seen as a reminder of the divine power and strength that resides within every individual. It is a call to harness that power in a spirit of compassion and kindness, and to use it in the service of others and the greater good. The name also serves as a reminder of the power of gentle words and actions, and of the profound impact they can have on the lives of those around us. Ultimately, the name Jabaz is a reminder of the divine balance between strength and compassion, and an invitation to embody that balance in our own lives.
